name: Chest Press Machine
instructions: Sit vertically, align handles with mid-chest, and press forward firmly.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench, hold dumbbells at chest level, and press directly upward.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand in the middle of a cable tower, pull handles down and together across your body.

name: Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, extend arms upward with soft elbows, and lower out to the sides.

name: Pec Deck Machine
instructions: Sit with back flat against pad, place forearms on pads, and bring elbows together in front.

name: Push-Ups
instructions: Maintain a rigid plank position, lower chest to floor, and push up explosively.

name: Incline Machine Press
instructions: Adjust seat for incline angle, grip handles above upper chest, and press upward.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30 degrees, hold dumbbells at collarbone height, and press straight up.

name: Assisted Dip Machine
instructions: Place knees on padded platform, lower body until elbows hit 90 degrees, and push up.

name: Parallel Bar Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars, lean torso slightly forward, lower until elbows reach 90 degrees, and drive up.

name: Lat Pulldown Machine
instructions: Grip wide bar above head, pull bar down toward upper chest while driving elbows down.

name: Pull-Ups
instructions: Grip overhead bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and pull chin over the bar.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with knees slightly bent, pull V-bar attachment into lower abdomen, squeezing shoulder blades.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on bench, pull dumbbell up toward hip with elbow tucked.

name: Leverage ISO Row Machine
instructions: Place chest against support pad, grip handles, and drive elbows straight back.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips with flat back, hold dumbbells hanging down, and pull toward waist.

name: Back Extension Machine
instructions: Adjust leg pads, hinge forward at hips, and contract lower back muscles to extend upright.

name: Bodyweight Hyperextensions
instructions: Lock feet on hyperextension bench, lower torso to 90 degrees, and raise back to parallel.

name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
instructions: Place knees on pad, grip handles wide, and let machine counterweight assist your pull-up.

name: Inverted Bodyweight Row
instructions: Lie under a fixed bar, hang with arms straight, and pull chest up to the bar.

name: Leg Press Machine
instructions: Place feet shoulder-width on platform, release safety catch, lower weight to 90 degrees, and drive up.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically against chest, squat deep keeping chest upright, and stand.

name: Seated Leg Extension Machine
instructions: Place lower shins under pad, extend legs straight out until quad contracts completely.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, step forward into a lunge until back knee nearly touches ground.

name: Lying Leg Curl Machine
instructions: Lie prone with lower calves under pad, flex hamstrings to curl pad toward glutes.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs, hinge hips back with flat spine until stretch in hamstrings.

name: Hack Squat Machine
instructions: Position shoulders under pads, unlock weight, squat down to parallel, and press back up.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place rear foot on bench, hold dumbbells at sides, lower back knee toward floor, and drive up.

name: Seated Calf Raise Machine
instructions: Place lower thighs under pad, drop heels toward floor, then extend ankles upward high.

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, balance on ball of feet on a step, lower heels, and rise high on toes.

name: Seated Overhead Shoulder Press Machine
instructions: Sit with back firmly supported, grip handles at ear level, and press straight up overhead.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on upright bench, bring dumbbells to shoulder height, and press vertically overhead.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Attach low pulley handle, pull cable across body and out to the side until arm is parallel to floor.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand upright holding dumbbells at sides, raise arms outward to 90 degrees keeping slight elbow bend.

name: Reverse Pec Deck Machine
instructions: Face inside the machine, grip handles at chest height, and sweep arms back to hit rear delts.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Flyes
instructions: Hinge forward at waist with flat back, hold dumbbells below chest, and raise outward.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Position bench under bar, unhook safety latches at shoulder height, and press bar straight up.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells at chest with palms facing you, rotate palms forward as you press upward.

name: Cable Front Raise
instructions: Grip low pulley handle between legs, raise arm straight in front to shoulder height, and lower down.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells on front thighs, lift one arm straight out in front to eye level, and alternate.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Attach rope or bar to high cable, keep elbows pinned at sides, and push attachment straight down.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell with both hands overhead, lower behind head by flexing elbows, and press up.

name: Machine Biceps Curl
instructions: Rest upper arms on preacher pad, grip handles, and flex biceps to curl weight up.

name: Standing Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with arms fully extended, rotate palms up, and curl toward shoulders.

name: Cable Preacher Curl Machine
instructions: Position arms on angled pad, pull low cable bar upward while isolating biceps.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other) and curl weight straight up.

name: Seated Dip Machine
instructions: Grip handles at hip level, press down extending elbows completely, and return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickbacks
instructions: Hinge torso parallel to floor, pin upper arm at side, and extend dumbbell straight back.

name: Cable Overhead Rope Extension
instructions: Attach rope to high pulley, face away from stack, press rope forward overhead extending triceps.

name: Bodyweight Bench Dips
instructions: Place hands on bench behind hips, extend legs forward, lower hips toward floor, and push up.
